activity_summary: You went to evening prayer at Holy Trinity. The prayers were the ordinary ones. Your feet had already been in salt water. You walked back to the house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Attended, and walked back to Henley Street.

facets.activity: Stood the ordinary prayers and walked back

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Evening prayer. The ordinary prayers, and then out again

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: They will do for the walk back
